name: Etrea
desc:
Etrea, also known as the Kingdom of Etrea, is a nation of primarily Etreans that are the main ruling faction in the [Etrean Luminant](location:luminants). They reside in their capital of [Etris](location:etris).

The [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils) is also part of Etrea, acting as its military school, though Etrea's attitude toward the Isle is much more hands-off.

Being the largest land ruling faction in the Etrean [Luminant](location:luminants), they hold a large range of power, deploying foot-soldiers all across the Etrean Luminant. They are led by the [Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent) who rules from his castle, and sees over the land of [Etris](location:etris) and the [Etrean Wilds](location:etrean_wilds). They had been ruled by their Kings for generations, until decades to months before the year 1271, when the new leader Lord Regent took over.

The kingdom has faced much hardship over the years. [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) has deemed them their next target for conquest, and they are far better armed and equipped than the Etrean people. Meanwhile, the Lord Regent is actually a Contractor and Ministry Prophet, essentially making them a puppet state for [the Ministry](faction:the_ministry), which has since only bolstered the Authority's resolve to destroy them.

The soldiers in Etris are purely Etrean, with the [Mantra Collector](entity:mantra_collector) sitting at the bottom near the docks being a Canor. If you go up to Schnitzel and talk to them, you will be given the normal dialogue options, as well as a third, "Why aren't you up in town?" Upon asking this question, Schnitzel will say "Canor no allowed to buy in town, new leader very strange." While many take this to mean they are racist, the Etreans welcomed three Adret into their capital, two of whom were [Divers](faction:the_divers), as well as a Vesperian, implying there was a different reason for Schnitzel's banishment that is currently unknown.
additional_info:
-   Like other major factions, they seem to be based on a real-world culture, with Etrea being based on East Asian countries like Japan and China.
-   In the Kings Garden, much like in Vigils and the hidden village, there is a fountain, it is located next to Lord Regents Palace
-   interestingly, the Etrea logo is similar to the Deepwoken logo, only flipped.
-   You used to be able to gain Reputation with Etrea from beating the Blade Instructor enemy, but this is no longer possible with the introduction of Training Mode having completely removed it.
